name: stencil-hrms
description: Stencil HRMS — multi-tenant human resource management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @stencil/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @stencil/web dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @stencil/api dev:memory" "corepack pnpm --filter @stencil/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @stencil/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @stencil/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @stencil/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @stencil/mobile typecheck
